verdict.rationale: Stable offers free high-res scans and auto-routes mail on keywords found inside the mail and on the envelope, which implies text extraction (OCR). It also provides AI summaries of contents, and its API supports searching MailItems. However, no evidence explicitly names OCR or describes searching the archive by sender, content, or date. Missing for 10: explicit OCR documentation, documented search filters by sender/content/date, full-text archive search in the dashboard, independent or hands-on corroboration.
